body:
speak now's 1,047,000-copy week nearly doubled what fearless opened to — and was the biggest sales week any female country artist had logged since 1991. all 14 standard-edition tracks on it, hers alone. 🤍

altText: Taylor Swift performing the Speak Now set of the Eras Tour in Inglewood, 2023, in a sparkling lilac ball gown, playing a blue acoustic guitar under purple stage lighting.

critique.rationale: A contradiction-led deep cut: the year of 'does she even write her own songs,' answered by an album written entirely alone — all 14 standard-edition tracks — that then opened to 1,047,000 copies, the first million-copy week since Tha Carter III. On-era Speak Now photo, warm fan voice.

why: X sibling of the Speak Now heartbeat pair; takes a distinct angle from IG (the Fearless-doubling and female-country-since-1991 records vs IG's Tha Carter III / fourth-woman framing) to clear the cross-post-copy check. One idea + link. X binds to the original (xOriginal) of the IG variant per the W8 Instagram-ready-variant rule — same photo, sanctioned same-campaign pair.
